name: bgwriter_lru_multiplier
description: Multiplier applied to the average recent buffer usage to determine how many dirty buffers the background writer flushes per cycle.
symptoms: High I/O wait during peak writes
Buffer starvation under heavy DML load
Increased transaction latency due to synchronous writes
tuning_tips: Increase for write-heavy workloads with large shared_buffers to reduce foreground write pressure; decrease if background writer activity causes I/O contention. Monitor pg_stat_bgwriter to assess effectiveness.
